<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034052026-11-1305-28-35" status="reviewed">
               <milestone unit="section" n="Verses (90b-91a2)"/>
           <lg><l> <lb n="90b9"/> <rs type="deity">thub pa</rs>'i legs gsungs chos 'dul gsang chen mtsho'i ||</l> 
            <l>snying dang snying po <expan>rdo rje</expan> lta bu 'di ||</l> 
            <l>byis pa so so'i blo'i yul min kyang || </l>
            <l>bshad lung 'grel pa mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs nas ||</l>
            <l>gzhan gyis bskul dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma</rs>'i gsung gnas phyir ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="work">legs bshad sgron me</rs> bkod pa mi rigs med || </l>
            
            <l>rgyal ba'i bka' lung <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4706"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3690">so sor thar pa</rs>'i ti <lb n="91a1"/> ka legs bshad</rs> ces bya ba ||</l> 
            <l>phrag dog med cing bslab par 'dod rnams dga' bas rgyas par byed pa 'di || </l>
            <l>nyan la brtson pa dman cing bshad pa'i go cha bgos pas bskul nas byas ||  </l>
            <l>gal te 'di la 'khrul pa mchis na dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzod || </l></lg>

            <lg><l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3690">rtsa ba'i lung</rs> 'di rnam par phye ba las || </l>
            <l>bsod nams <lb n="91a2"/> grub pas 'jig rten ma ku lus kun || </l>
           <l> dam pa brten cing tshul gnas legs bslabs te || </l>
           <l> bdag gzhan don rdzogs thub pa'i dbang por shog || </l></lg>

            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3969">b+hi k+Shu d+ha r+ma shwa rwa</rs>s <note type="editorial">=Skt. dharmeśvara</note> legs par sbyar ba'o | || || | </seg></TEI>
source: 2_034_05_ Chos kyi dbang phyug _ rtsa ba'i lung so sor thar pa'i TIk+ka legs par bkod pa.xml
